conflicts.explainedBy: partly generation (W1 table 1000 km vs W2 table 3000 km); ES document is internally inconsistent (text 1000 km vs table 3000 km); IL service spacing vs manual unexplained

conflicts.note: IL press conflicts on the IL Jet 14 125 cooling type: FullgaZ 2017 news says 'מקורר נוזל', FullgaZ 2018 road test says air-cooled. Need the VIN/model code (XC12W1 vs XC12WW/WY etc.) of the actual B9 scooter.

notes: Both official manuals are multi-model (Jet 14 50/125/200) and state no model years; the W1 codes (Euro 4 era) vs W2 codes (newer edition, presumably Euro 5) is an inference from code suffixes, not stated. Which edition applies to an IL MY2021 Jet 14 125 is unconfirmed - check the VIN/type code (XC12W1 / XC12W2 = air-cooled 125; XC12WW/WY/WX/WZ = cooling-system variants). Jet 14 EVO is a separate, later liquid-cooled model (sanyang.co.il) and is not covered by these schedules. Both manuals are the same manufacturer's schedule in two editions (not independent publishers), though they are distinct documents. Table cell positions were read from rendered page images; quotes for table rows are the row text as printed (row number, item, codes). Shock-tension-bar (inspect every 10000 km, replace every 30000 km, ES only) and other I-only rows (suspension, stands, bolts) omitted as outside the task-code list. No IL importer schedule document was readable; the IL cost table (2018 press) is the only IL-market evidence.
